problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14073682/assets/bd69636822b7a3f68805273a4ffd72c7011a4f945a3ebbac8dcd99191e7ea730.png)

Change the order of integration in the integral

$$
{\int }_{0}^{3}{\int }_{0}^{(3-x)/3}{\int }_{0}^{3-x-3y}f(x,y,z)\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x
$$

so that it is integrated first with respect to $x,$ then over a region $D$ in the $yz$-plane. The integration region $R$ is shown above.
